name: Matteo Louis Casling
tagline: Senior Multimedia Producer, 3D Motion Designer & UN Communications Strategist
welcomeHeadline: Translating Complex Global Mandates & Technical Systems into High-Retention Visual Cinema.
welcomeBody: As a communications specialist and multimedia producer with over six years of experience across the United Nations system (UN DESA, IAEA, FAO, IFAD) and broadcast news (PBS News), I build versatile, impact-oriented visual ecosystems that blend strategy, storytelling, and engineering. My work spans the full spectrum of multimedia production - from location directing and 3D Blender/Unreal animations to Drupal 10 digital platforms and flagship COP summit cinema.
dualTrackUnSummary: Direct background in sovereign development finance (INFFs), climate science diplomacy (COP28 Dubai / COP29 Baku), and emergency agricultural crisis communications across 4 UN agencies.
dualTrackTechSummary: End-to-end timeline & pipeline ownership combining Premiere Pro, After Effects, Blender 3D, Unreal Engine 5, Remotion, Audition sound mastering, and Drupal 10 / Astro web engineering.
